title: Insight into modulating osteoarthritis progression: lncRNAs and TGF-beta/Smad signalling pathway.
authors: Li, Chao; Yang, Yinwei; Zhang, Yunze; Guo, Pei; Dong, Yixin; Ma, Yuanbo; Zhu, Mengqi; Li, Lingrui; Han, Yu
one_liner_zh: 综述lncRNA通过TGF-beta/Smad通路调控骨关节炎进展，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) are a class of non-coding RNA molecules with a length of more than 200 nucleotides that play key roles in the regulation of gene expression and cell physiology. Studies have shown that lncRNAs can participate in the regulation of the TGF-beta/Smad signalling pathway by sponging miRNAs or directly activating Smad protein phosphorylation. The TGF-beta/Smad signalling pathway has become a key signalling pathway in osteoarthritis (OA), a traditional degenerative joint disease characterised by an imbalance between cartilage degradation and repair. This review systematically discusses the molecular mechanisms by which lncRNAs regulate OA cartilage repair through the TGF-beta/Smad signalling pathway, as well as the regulatory roles of these lncRNAs in inflammatory response, extracellular matrix (ECM) homeostasis, and chondrocyte apoptosis. In addition, the article also summarised the clinical transformation strategies based on lncRNA, including nanoparticle delivery systems (such as exosomes and hydrogels), gene editing technologies (such as CRISPR-Cas9), and precision treatment guided by dynamic biomarkers. Although lncRNA therapy still faces challenges in terms of targeted delivery efficiency and specificity, its potential in early diagnosis and regenerative therapy of OA provides a theoretical basis for the development of novel intervention methods. In the future, combining cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence, single-cell sequencing, and 3D organoids, the application of lncRNA regulatory networks is expected to open up new avenues for OA treatment.
abstract_zh: 长链非编码RNA（lncRNAs）是一类长度超过200个核苷酸的非编码RNA分子，在基因表达和细胞生理调控中发挥关键作用。研究表明，lncRNAs可通过海绵吸附miRNAs或直接激活Smad蛋白磷酸化，参与TGF-beta/Smad信号通路的调控。TGF-beta/Smad信号通路已成为骨关节炎（OA）中的关键信号通路，OA是一种以软骨降解与修复失衡为特征的传统退行性关节疾病。本综述系统探讨了lncRNAs通过TGF-beta/Smad信号通路调控OA软骨修复的分子机制，以及这些lncRNAs在炎症反应、细胞外基质（ECM）稳态和软骨细胞凋亡中的调控作用。此外，文章还总结了基于lncRNA的临床转化策略，包括纳米颗粒递送系统（如外泌体和水凝胶）、基因编辑技术（如CRISPR-Cas9）以及动态生物标志物引导的精准治疗。尽管lncRNA治疗在靶向递送效率和特异性方面仍面临挑战，但其在OA早期诊断和再生治疗中的潜力为开发新型干预方法提供了理论基础。未来，结合人工智能、单细胞测序和3D类器官等前沿技术，lncRNA调控网络的应用有望为OA治疗开辟新途径。
